newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Mt Leyshon annual gold production up 4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mt Leyshon annual gold production up 4 pct.

text.p: Mt Leyshon Gold Mines Ltd said on Monday its gold production rose four percent to 219,106 ounces for the 12 months ended June 30.
Fourth quarter gold production totalled 59,233 ounces.
Total cash costs for the year decreased 9.1 percent to A$330 per ounce while total cash costs for the quarter were 2.1 percent lower than in the previous quarter at A$320 per ounce.
Gold sales for the quarter were 61,618 ounces at a net average realised price of A$606 per ounce.
Mt Leyshon is about 75 percent owned by Normandy Mining Ltd.
